notes: P05 task SACMAT-X08_budget_runner (Equal-budget competitor benchmark for PolicyTrace RQ2). evaluation/venue2027/sacmat/budget_fair_runner.py (BUDGET_FAIR_RUNNER_VERSION 1.0.0) implements run_budget_fair(campaign, budget_config) -> BudgetRunResult and assert_budget_fairness(results) verifying every competitor strategy (sequence_aware, mcdc_static, random, coverage_guided) executed under strictly EQUAL oracle query budgets, generation CPU limits, and wall-clock timeouts. Records query_trace and cumulative fault_discovery_curve. Positive controls prove: all strategies consume <= allocated budget; sequence-aware candidate discovers temporal faults (MUT_SWAP_GRANT_REVOKE, MUT_REMOVE_REVOKE) that random misses at equal budget; MC/DC static testing kills static obligation mutants but misses temporal ordering swaps; fault discovery curves are monotonically non-decreasing; and results are JSON-serializable. Adversarial controls enforce fail-closed rejection: budget overruns raise BUDGET_OVERRUN, unequal budget allocations raise UNEQUAL_BUDGET_ALLOCATION, invalid budgets raise INVALID_BUDGET, unknown strategies raise UNKNOWN_STRATEGY, and empty campaigns raise EMPTY_CAMPAIGN. Tests: 25 passed in 0.36s (exit 0); ruff check and format check clean (exit 0).
